title: Signed line PullbackUnique
statement: For any ringed-site module pullback F, an isomorphism t:F(P)≅Q, and two signed-power isomorphism families T and T′, if both satisfy SignedLinePullbackNormalized [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data], then T=T′. The conclusion requires no rank-one hypothesis beyond the existence of the normalized families.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: The module pullback adjunction detects maps by their values on inserted source sections. In degree zero the normalization fixes the value, and in degree one it fixes t. Induct on positive powers, using tensor generation and the specified recursion to identify the maps.

For a negative power, postcompose the two maps with the internal-dual isomorphism induced by the common positive map. Both maps transfer the same evaluation pairing. Pairing-transfer uniqueness identifies them, and cancel the dual isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.
